name: Sorcerer Elementalist Sorcerer
body:
There are some sorcerers in whose veins flows not only the power of one element, but many.

Bloodline: An elementalist sorcerer must have the elemental bloodline.

Diminished Spellcasting: An elementalist sorcerer can cast one fewer spell per day of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, she can cast spells of that level only if her Charisma score grants her bonus spells of that level. Her number of sorcerer spells known is unchanged.

This ability alters the sorcerer’s spellcasting.

Elemental Spell (Ex)

An elementalist sorcerer gains Elemental Spell as a bonus feat at 1st level. She gains it again at 7th and 13th level, each time applying it to a different element among those she selected with her scion of many elements ability. This replaces eschew materials and the 7th- and 13th-level bloodline feats.

Scion of Many Elements

At 1st level, an elementalist sorcerer chooses two elements instead of one. Every time she uses her bloodline arcana, bloodline powers, and bloodline spells, she chooses which element she uses them with. At 10th level, she can select a third element to use her bloodline abilities with.
